widgets_values: The woman from <Picture 1> is sitting in a yacht, outside while the yacht is moving at high speed, she is wearing a bikini and drinking a tequila. The camera approaches from the side and she looks at the camera and says "Follow me", she then gets up and starts walking inside the boat and the camera follows
